answer: IFRS 16 (Leases) [IFRS]: A lessee recognises a right-of-use asset and a lease liability for almost every lease at commencement, the liability being the present value of unpaid payments at the rate implicit in the lease or the incremental borrowing rate. Whether to add them to net debt depends on whether EBITDA in the same ratio is before or after rent.
